components.repackage_recipe: Remove only each source file's safetensors __metadata__ entry; preserve source tensor order, dtype, shape, and raw data regions; shift every second-shard data offset by the first shard's data byte count; compact-encode the combined JSON header, pad it with spaces to an eight-byte boundary, then concatenate both original tensor-data regions byte-for-byte.
